claim: Tool search is on by default in Claude Code: MCP tool definitions are deferred and only names plus server instructions load at start.
quote: Tool search is enabled by default: MCP tools are deferred and discovered on demand.
title: MCP docs (tool search)

claim: ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto loads MCP tools upfront while their definitions total under 10% of context window; auto:N sets custom percent; false loads all upfront; unset/true defers all.
quote: At 10% or more, tool search turns on
title: MCP docs (ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH table)

claim: Tool search per MCP docs works on Sonnet 4/Opus 4/Haiku 4.5 and later; earlier models load all MCP tools upfront, and it is not supported on Azure-hosted Microsoft Foundry deployments.
quote: Tool search isn’t supported on Microsoft Foundry deployments hosted on Azure
title: MCP docs

claim: Setting MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS does not change the 50,000-character threshold above which successful MCP text results are saved to a file.
quote: Setting MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS doesn’t change this threshold
title: MCP docs (output limits)

claim: A server can raise a tool's save-to-file threshold via _meta anthropic/maxResultSizeChars, up to a 500,000-character ceiling.
quote: Claude Code raises that tool’s threshold to the annotated value, up to a hard ceiling of 500,000 characters.
title: MCP docs (output limits)

claim: Costs docs recommend CLI tools (gh, aws, gcloud, sentry-cli) over MCP servers for context efficiency; documented route for scripts is CLIs, not MCP calls from Bash.
quote: Tools like gh , aws , gcloud , and sentry-cli are still more context-efficient than MCP servers because they don’t add any per-tool listing.
title: Manage costs effectively

claim: Costs docs say hooks can preprocess data before Claude sees it (grep ERROR from a log), cutting tens of thousands of tokens to hundreds (docs assertion, not measured).
quote: Custom hooks can preprocess data before Claude sees it.
title: Manage costs effectively

claim: PostToolUse hooks can replace a tool's result with updatedToolOutput (all tools; updatedMCPToolOutput is MCP-only legacy).
quote: PostToolUse : updatedToolOutput replaces the tool’s result.
title: Hooks reference

claim: updatedToolOutput changes only what Claude sees; the tool has already run, and OTel spans capture the original output; trimming before run needs PreToolUse updatedInput.
quote: updatedToolOutput only changes what Claude sees. The tool has already run by the time the hook fires
title: Hooks reference

claim: The Claude Code Bash sandbox is OS-enforced, covers filesystem and network (network.allowedDomains), and is off by default; enable via /sandbox or sandbox.enabled.
quote: The sandbox is off by default.
title: Sandboxing

claim: Messages API programmatic tool calling lets Claude write code calling your tools inside a code execution container (allowed_callers with code_execution_20260120+); listed for Messages API, not Managed Agents; this is an API feature, not a Claude Code setting.
quote: Programmatic tool calling allows Claude to write code that calls your tools programmatically within a code execution container
title: Programmatic tool calling (API docs)

claim: Agent SDK/headless result: total_cost_usd and costUSD are client-side estimates, not billing data.
quote: The total_cost_usd and costUSD fields are client-side estimates, not authoritative billing data.
title: Track cost and usage

claim: Use modelUsage for whole-tree token accounting; result.usage undercounts with subagents.
quote: Use modelUsage , or model_usage in Python, for whole-tree token accounting; the usage field undercounts as soon as nesting occurs.
title: Track cost and usage

claim: OpenTelemetry metrics claude_code.token.usage and claude_code.cost.usage carry a model attribute (needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1).
quote: The model attribute is available on claude_code.token.usage , claude_code.cost.usage , and claude_code.lines_of_code.count .
title: Monitoring
